entities.name: Louis Michel Thibault
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Michel Thibault, was a French-born architect and engineer who designed numerous buildings in the Cape Colony. He was Cape Colony's first trained architect and brought with him a distinctive mannered neo-classicism.
